meta.title: Namag — Legal-Clause-Analyzer
meta.description: Privacy-first AI contract analysis running fully locally. Detect clauses, assess GDPR & EU AI Act readiness, score risk, and redline contracts — no cloud, no data leaving your machine.

hero.title: Every clause recorded. Every risk made clear.
hero.subtitle: Namag is a privacy-first contract analysis tool that runs entirely on your machine. Detect clauses, assess GDPR and EU AI Act readiness, score risk, and redline contracts with a local LLM — no cloud, no contract data ever leaving your computer.

problem.title: Contract review is slow, manual, and risky
problem.body: Legal teams review hundreds of contracts every week, yet most clause analysis is done by hand. Meanwhile, the EU AI Act and GDPR impose obligations that many contracts fail to address — and sending confidential drafts to cloud AI tools is a privacy risk in itself.

points.title: Manual and expensive
points.body: Clause analysis is slow, inconsistent, and costly when done by hand.

points.title: Compliance blind spots
points.body: GDPR and EU AI Act requirements are easy to miss in long, dense contracts.

points.title: Cloud is a liability
points.body: Confidential contracts should never be sent to external AI services.

steps.title: Upload a contract
steps.body: Provide a PDF, DOCX, or plain-text contract. Everything stays on your machine.

steps.title: Deterministic analysis
steps.body: Clause detection, GDPR readiness, and EU AI Act checks run rule-based — no network calls.

steps.title: Optional local LLM
steps.body: Enable Llama 3 via Ollama to add a grounded compliance summary and refined redlining.

steps.title: Review every change
steps.body: Nothing is modified automatically. Every suggestion requires a human decision.

steps.title: Export a report
steps.body: Generate a professional, color-coded PDF with cited legal references.

items.title: Clause detection
items.body: Detects force majeure, limitation of liability, termination, confidentiality, data protection, AI systems, indemnification, and governing law clauses.

items.title: GDPR readiness
items.body: Identifies personal and sensitive data language and flags missing GDPR controls.

items.title: EU AI Act readiness
items.body: Detects high-risk AI terms and surfaces control gaps such as human oversight and transparency.

items.title: Risk scoring
items.body: Scores overall risk plus GDPR and EU AI Act readiness on a 0–100 scale.

items.title: AI redlining
items.body: Playbook-driven negotiation suggestions for EU and US commercial contracts, always lawyer-reviewable.

items.title: Contract comparison
items.body: Side-by-side structured diff of two contracts with score deltas.

items.title: PDF reports
items.body: Color-coded analysis, comparison, and redline reports, generated on demand.

items.title: Grounded summaries
items.body: Opt-in local LLM summaries tied to retrieved legal references — no invented facts.

architecture.title: A modular, local-first pipeline
architecture.body: A FastAPI application following clean architecture and SOLID principles. Contracts are extracted, analyzed by deterministic rules, scored, and optionally enriched by a local LLM grounded in a curated legal corpus.

items.title: Ingestion
items.body: PDF and DOCX extraction plus plain-text input.

items.title: Rule-based engine
items.body: Deterministic clause detection and compliance checks.

items.title: Redlining engine
items.body: Playbook-driven suggestions with confidence scoring.

items.title: Risk scoring
items.body: Overall, GDPR, and EU AI Act scores on a 0–100 scale.

items.title: RAG pipeline
items.body: ChromaDB vector store with sentence-transformers embeddings and top-3 retrieval.

items.title: Local LLM
items.body: Llama 3 via Ollama, opt-in per request, with graceful fallback.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Professional PDF reports with cited legal sources.

privacy.title: Private by architecture
privacy.body: Zero external API calls. All processing runs locally or inside Docker, so confidential contract text never leaves your machine.

items.title: Local AI execution
items.body: Llama 3 runs through Ollama on your own hardware.

items.title: Privacy by design
items.body: On-premise processing means no cloud provider ever sees your contracts.

items.title: Human control
items.body: Approve or reject every suggested change; the tool never edits automatically.

items.title: Traceability
items.body: LLM summaries are grounded in retrieved references shown with title, filename, and excerpt.

items.title: Compliance readiness
items.body: GDPR and EU AI Act readiness checks — readiness, not certification.

items.title: Practical deployment
items.body: Docker image with health checks and non-root execution.

limitations.title: Honest about what it can't do
limitations.intro: Namag is a compliance-readiness tool for legal professionals, not a substitute for qualified legal review.

items.title: Keyword-based detection
items.body: Clause detection relies on keyword matching, not semantic NLP; paraphrased clauses may be missed.

items.title: English only
items.body: Keyword rules, playbooks, and the knowledge base are all in English.

items.title: Single-file analysis
items.body: No batch or multi-document workflows.

items.title: LLM quality varies
items.body: Llama 3 summaries and refinements are approximate and always require human review.

items.title: No persistent storage
items.body: Results are held in memory only; there is no database or history.

items.title: No authentication
items.body: The API has no auth layer and is not intended for direct public internet exposure.

items.title: Playbook coverage
items.body: Ships with EU and US general commercial playbooks; other jurisdictions require manual authoring.

limitations.note: Risk scores are an internal 0–100 assessment, not a legal judgment. Readiness checks are not certification.

opensource.title: Free, open, and tested
opensource.body: Namag is MIT-licensed and open source. The full suite of 96 tests passes on every push and pull request.

items.title: MIT license

items.title: CI on GitHub Actions

items.title: Docker with health checks

about.title: Why the name Namag
about.body1: Namag is maintained by Soheil Onsori, a law graduate (LL.B.) and developer building privacy-first AI tools for legal work. He is the author of the Post-Meeting Legal Analyzer and holds a Legal Engineering Certification from Harvey Academy and Anthropic's AI Fluency credential. His focus is the intersection of legal reasoning, applied AI, and compliance — GDPR and the EU AI Act. The builder is not a licensed attorney: this project does not offer legal representation, certification, or regulatory approval.
about.body2: Namag — from the Middle Persian nāmag: a letter, a document, a written record. The word lives on in Persian today as nāme — the letter that carries a message from one person to another. I named this tool after that idea: every contract deserves a written, verifiable analysis.
